subject: Novatix — DPA cross-border exceptions & evidence plan
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@novatix.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Natalie Green <natalie.green@novatix.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 09:18:00 -0500
Subject: DPA questions — SCCs carveouts and evidence for EU deployment

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're close to procurement approval but legal flagged a couple of items in the DPA/SCCs that will block our security review: specifically a carveout for cross-border subprocessors, evidence for subprocessor locations, and a narrow exception path for customer-requested EU-only routing.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can:
- Provide a short evidence pack showing subprocessor hosting countries and KMS residency for the models that will serve our workloads (prod region: eu-west-1).
- Accept a limited export carveout in the DPA for specific analytics endpoints while keeping SCCs intact for PII flows.
- Support an order-form-level routing flag that pins data to EU-only model variants for the first 12 months.

If this is something we can resolve via an addendum and a short evidence schedule, procurement can proceed.

Appreciate a timeline — Natalie and I are coordinating with procurement/legal.

Thanks,
Liam
Account Lead, Novatix

--

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@novatix.com>
Cc: Natalie Green <natalie.green@novatix.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2026 12:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: DPA questions — SCCs carveouts and evidence for EU deployment

Hi Liam,

Really glad we're at this stage. Short answers up front: yes to evidence pack; likely yes to order-form routing flag (we've done this for other EU customers); carveout language needs legal review but we can propose narrow language that preserves SCC coverage for PII flows and limits analytics endpoints.

I'll loop in our privacy/contract team to draft a proposed addendum and an evidence schedule. Can you share the procurement calendar (dates when contract must be signed) so we can prioritize?

Next steps I propose:
- Internal redline and proposed language from Redwood by EOD Mon (15 Feb).
- Evidence pack (high-level: subprocessor list, hosting countries, KMS residency statement) delivered by 18 Feb.
- Order-form flag mechanics call if you want a quick sync (15-30m).

CCing Karthik to lead redlines; Karthik — can you take point on the DPA carveout language and loop in Laura for the SCCs/evidence artifacts?

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 10:06:00 -0500
Subject: Fwd: Novatix DPA carveout — internal draft notes

Team — drafting notes for the DPA addendum. I'm attaching an internal redline (v3) that trims the proposed carveout to only non-personally-identifiable analytics endpoints and requires explicit opt-in via order form. High-level issues to confirm:

1) Scope of carveout: keep SCCs fully applicable to any PII; carveout limited to aggregated usage metrics for model telemetry. Proposed clause text: "Provider may process aggregated, non-personally-identifiable telemetry collected from Customer accounts for the purposes of service quality improvement and aggregated analytics; such processing shall not be considered a cross-border transfer of Personal Data under this DPA." We need legal to vet whether that phrasing is safe.

2) Routing flag: implement as an order-form boolean "eu_residency_required" that pins requests to EU-only model variants and EU-hosted KV cache. Operational note: routing adds cost; include short note in order form.

3) Evidence pack: propose two artifacts — (a) subprocessor list with country column; (b) KMS residency attestation for models (HS-signed PDF). We can produce redwood_transfer_impact_summary.pdf covering the short timeline and controls.

4) Timeline: Suggest we aim to send the redlined DPA and order form markup to Novatix on Mon 15 Feb and the evidence pack by Wed 18 Feb.

Laura/Monica — any callouts on SCC compatibility or escalation items? Please push any suggested alternative phrasing into the attached doc.

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Privacy & Contracts — Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: novatix_dpa_redline_v3.docx (internal draft)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Natalie Green <natalie.green@novatix.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@novatix.com>
Cc: Aisha Rana <aisha.rana@novatix.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2026 17:40:00 -0500
Subject: Proposed DPA addendum + order-form flag (Novatix)

Hi Natalie / Liam — attaching Redwood's proposed redline v3 and a short transfer-impact summary. Key points in this package:

- Narrow analytics carveout: language limited to aggregated telemetry only; explicit exclusion of PII and no change to SCC obligations. (See section 2.1 of the redline.)
- Order-form residency flag: we added an "eu_residency_required" boolean that, when checked, pins routing to EU-hosted model variants and KV caches for the initial 12-month term. Operational note included about potential throughput/cost impact.
- Evidence pack outline: subprocessor list (country column) + KMS residency attestation (to follow as HS-signed PDF).

Asks from Novatix:
1) Please confirm whether the analytics carveout scope (aggregated telemetry only) is acceptable to Legal.
2) Confirm procurement timeline so we can prioritize the HS-signed KMS attestation.
3) If you want a live 30-minute call this week to walk the order-form flag, say which day/time works.

I'll route any requested edits back to Karthik/Laura for legal rework.

Best regards,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: novatix_dpa_redline_v3.docx, redwood_transfer_impact_summary.pdf
From: Aisha Rana <aisha.rana@novatix.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Natalie Green <natalie.green@novatix.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@novatix.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 16:42:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Proposed DPA addendum + order-form flag (Novatix)

Hi Grace / Karthik — thanks for the rapid turnaround and the clear package. Quick summary from our side after an internal legal read:

- The narrow aggregated telemetry carveout is potentially acceptable but Legal needs an explicit assurance that no PII or re-identification flows are possible. Could Redwood add a short non-reidentification guarantee clause and a sample data schema for telemetry?
- Order-form residency flag is fine in principle; procurement will include that line item. Please provide an estimated delta on cost (ballpark) when routing to EU-only variants so our finance team can assess impact.
- Evidence pack request approved; we need the KMS residency attestation by 18 Feb EOD to meet our signing window — is that achievable? If not, we'll accept a staged delivery plan: (1) subprocessor country list + hosting zones by 18 Feb; (2) HS-signed KMS attestation within 5 business days after.

If you can accept the non-reidentification clause and the staged evidence plan, Legal is comfortable moving forward and procurement will prepare the order form. We'll aim to sign the MSA + DPA next week pending the KMS attestation.

Can someone from Redwood confirm the staged timeline and provide the cost delta estimate?

Thanks,
Aisha Rana
Senior Counsel — Novatix
